intro: Say goodbye to shoe clutter and hello to organised elegance with the Meraki shoe cabinet. Crafted to simplify your life, It is more than just a storage solution – it’s a touch of finesse.

features.title: Stores up to 12-16 shoe pairs
features.text: Accommodates up to 16 pairs of shoes, ensuring every pair finds a secure spot. Adjusts to varying shoe sizes, from sneakers to stilettos, seamlessly.

features.title: Integrated drawer for care essentials
features.text: Keep your shoe care products close at hand. With an integrated drawer, you can easily store polishes, brushes, and other essentials, so maintaining your shoes is as convenient as it gets.

features.title: Durable particle board material
features.text: Built to last, this cabinet is crafted from high-quality particle board that offers strength and longevity, meaning your shoe storage solution will stand the test of time.

features.title: PU-laminated finish in brown and beige
features.text: Designed to complement modern interiors, the sleek brown and beige finish adds warmth and sophistication, making it a perfect fit for any space.

features.title: Knock-down design for easy assembly
features.text: No more complicated setups. With its thoughtful knock-down design, assembly is simple, giving you more time to enjoy a tidy, stylish space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Meraki 16 Pairs Engineered Wood Shoe Cabinet
